topic: National Anti Counterfeiting Product Integrity and Quality Standards Bill

findings.title: Constitution of India, Article 21, Seventh Schedule List I Item 49, List III Item 33, Item 34

official_sources.pinpoint: Article 21 (Life and Safety), List I Item 49 (Patents, trademarks and copyright), List III Item 33 (Trade and commerce), Item 34 (Price control and standards)

findings.limitations: Right to life includes protection from hazardous, sub-standard, and fake life-saving commodities as affirmed in Centre for Public Interest Litigation v. Union of India (2013) 16 SCC 279.

findings.title: Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016; Consumer Protection Act, 2019; Trade Marks Act, 1999; Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023

official_sources.pinpoint: BIS Act 2016, Consumer Protection Act 2019, BNS 2023

findings.limitations: Existing acts are fragmented, lack mandatory digital track-and-trace serialization across all consumer supply chains, lack asset forfeiture of counterfeiting syndicates, and fail to impose strict e-commerce platform liability.

gaps: Absence of a unified National Anti-Counterfeiting enforcement authority with digital track-and-trace powers.
Lack of severe mandatory minimum criminal sentences (up to life imprisonment) for life-critical counterfeits.
Absence of summary asset forfeiture of commercial counterfeiting syndicates and mandatory 10x consumer compensation.
